summary: Command-line tool that attributes each customer contact (enquiry) to an order. With the legacy strategies it does a per-group as-of join to the latest prior order; with --strategy by_erc it routes WISMO contacts through a three-check rule over a look-back window, and sends Returns and other contacts to as-of. It writes the attributed contacts to parquet.
inputs: --contacts parquet file (contact rows with a date column, plus ERC, diary-code and intention columns for by_erc)
--orders parquet file (order rows with order date, delivery date and optional adjustment-code list)
outputs: --out parquet file: contacts joined to orders, with an attrib_strategy column in by_erc mode
printed null rates, ERC bucket counts, strategy distribution and matched percentage

n1.summary: Defines the WISMO (4101, 4102) and Returns (seven codes) ERC sets used to route contacts.

n2.summary: Default look-back windows: WISMO 30 days, code-match 60 days, Returns 60 days; used as CLI defaults.

n3.summary: Defines the attrib_strategy label strings written to the output column.

n4.summary: Default intention labels that route WISMO contacts to the GNR/DOR check, used when no CLI override is given.

n5.summary: Defines the CLI: required --contacts, --orders, --contact-date, --order-date, --by and --out. --strategy defaults to backward and also accepts forward, nearest and by_erc. --erc-col defaults to ENQUIRY_REASON_CODE. Window flags default to the module constants. Optional diary, intention, adj-code and GNR/DOR flags are included. Parses argv into args.
n5.watch: --delivery-date has no required=True; it is only checked later, and only for by_erc.

n6.summary: Reads both parquet files fully into memory as polars DataFrames and prints their row counts.

b7.summary: If --strategy is by_erc, runs the ERC-aware dispatch (n8, n9, n10). Otherwise runs legacy as-of attribution (n11) with the chosen strategy.

n8.summary: Exits with a parser error if --delivery-date is missing; builds the GNR/DOR intention set from the CLI list or the default.
n8.watch: An empty --gnr-dor-intentions list is falsy, so it falls back to the default set.

n9.summary: Runs ERC-aware attribution with the CLI columns, windows and intention set. Passes no return_indicator_col. The output has an attrib_strategy label per contact, and the result is held in memory as out.
n9.watch: The Returns rule is only a hook; Returns contacts get plain as-of.

n10.summary: prints attrib_strategy counts, most frequent first

n11.summary: Legacy path: attributes each contact to the latest prior order (or forward/nearest) within the --by groups. Adds no attrib_strategy column and ignores ERC and delivery date.
n11.watch: Rows with null dates are dropped here, so out can have fewer rows than the input contacts.

n12.summary: counts and prints rows with a non-null order date
n12.watch: Divides by out.height, so it raises ZeroDivisionError if out is empty.

n13.summary: Creates the output directory if needed and writes out to --out as parquet, overwriting any existing file. Prints the path.

h14.summary: Helper that attributes WISMO contacts via bucketed checks; called by attribute_by_erc.

attribute_contacts_to_orders/n1.summary: rejects strategies other than backward, forward, nearest

attribute_contacts_to_orders/n3.summary: Counts null dates on each side and prints the rates, which feed the drop-or-raise decision.

attribute_contacts_to_orders/n4.summary: If any null dates exist, raises when drop_null_dates is False, else filters those rows out of both frames.
attribute_contacts_to_orders/n4.watch: Dropped contacts vanish from the result rather than appearing with null order columns.

attribute_contacts_to_orders/n5.summary: Sorts both frames by by_cols plus their date column, as join_asof requires.

attribute_contacts_to_orders/n6.summary: Left as-of join of contacts to orders on contact_date_col against order_date_col, grouped by by_cols, using the given strategy (default backward, so the order date is at most the contact date). Contacts without a match keep null order columns. Output is sorted by group and date.
attribute_contacts_to_orders/n6.watch: The result order differs from the input order.

_attribute_wismo/n1.summary: raises if the code-match window is narrower than the main window

_attribute_wismo/n2.summary: Sets three flags saying whether the diary code column, the intention column and the order adj-code column are present. Missing columns switch off the related checks rather than raising.
_attribute_wismo/n2.watch: A column name that is misspelled counts as absent, so the contact silently falls into a lower bucket.

_attribute_wismo/n3.summary: Adds a _contact_idx row id to contacts, then inner-joins to every order sharing the by_cols values, giving one row per contact-order pair.
_attribute_wismo/n3.watch: Inner join: contacts with no orders in their group drop out here and are restored at the end. This can be a large intermediate.

_attribute_wismo/n4.summary: Defines the window bounds as contact date minus window_days (main) and minus code_match_window_days (wider). Keeps pairs with order_date in [contact − code window, contact], and flags _in_window_main for the narrower window.
_attribute_wismo/n4.watch: Orders dated after the contact are excluded.

_attribute_wismo/n5.summary: If no pair is in window, returns every contact with null order columns and a null attrib_strategy, so the caller can fall back to as-of. Otherwise continues.
_attribute_wismo/n5.watch: This early return skips the remaining steps.

_attribute_wismo/n6.summary: Adds _in_flight (delivery null or after contact) and _delivered_before (delivery not null and before contact) flags.

_attribute_wismo/n7.summary: Builds _adj_codes_norm, the order adj-code list with padding stripped, or a null list when no adj column exists.

_attribute_wismo/n8.summary: Computes _adj_matches, true when the diary code is in the order's adj-code list; false for all rows if either column is missing.

_attribute_wismo/n9.summary: Starts the bucket expression: bucket A when the diary code is not null, else a never-true clause.

_attribute_wismo/n10.summary: If an intention column exists, adds bucket B for intentions in the GNR/DOR set.

_attribute_wismo/n11.summary: Closes the expression with bucket C as the default and adds the _bucket column.

_attribute_wismo/n12.summary: Assigns _tier: 0 for a primary match (A: adj match, any in-code-window order; B: delivered before and in main window; C: in flight and in main window), 1 for any other in-main-window order, else 99, which is dropped. Adds _tiebreak_score: oldest order date for C tier 0, latest delivery date for B tier 0, latest order date otherwise.
_attribute_wismo/n12.watch: Rows outside the main window survive only as bucket A tier-0 code matches.

_attribute_wismo/n13.summary: Sorts by contact id, tier, tiebreak score, then ORDER_SERIAL_NUMBER if present, and takes the first row per contact.

_attribute_wismo/n14.summary: Turns (bucket, tier) into an attrib_strategy label (six WISMO labels) and drops the temporary columns.

_attribute_wismo/n15.summary: Left-joins the picked order columns and attrib_strategy back onto all indexed contacts by _contact_idx, then drops the index. Contacts with no in-window order keep null order columns and a null strategy; the caller sends them to as-of.
_attribute_wismo/n15.watch: The slim picked frame has no by_cols or contact columns, so only order-side columns and attrib_strategy are brought back.

attribute_by_erc/n1.summary: asserts the date and ERC columns exist

attribute_by_erc/n2.summary: raises TypeError if the order or delivery date is a String

attribute_by_erc/n3.summary: prints null rates for the three timestamps

attribute_by_erc/n4.summary: Builds boolean expressions testing whether the ERC is in the WISMO set or the Returns set.

attribute_by_erc/n5.summary: Splits contacts into WISMO, Returns and Other. Other holds everything else plus null-ERC rows. The three groups cover every contact once.
attribute_by_erc/n5.watch: A null ERC makes is_in return null, so the extra is_null clause is what puts those rows in Other.

attribute_by_erc/n6.summary: prints the contact count for each bucket

attribute_by_erc/n7.summary: Creates the empty list that collects each branch's attributed frame.

attribute_by_erc/b8.summary: Runs the WISMO attribution only if there are WISMO contacts.

attribute_by_erc/n9.summary: Runs the three-check WISMO attribution on the WISMO contacts, passing the main and code-match windows, diary, intention and adj-code columns and the GNR/DOR set. Returns the contacts with order columns and attrib_strategy; contacts with no in-window order are left null.

attribute_by_erc/n10.summary: Splits the WISMO result by whether attrib_strategy is null. Hits are appended to parts; misses go on to as-of. Prints hit and miss counts and a strategy mix.
attribute_by_erc/n10.watch: Only wismo_hit is appended here; wismo_miss rows are not in parts until the fallback runs.

attribute_by_erc/b11.summary: Runs the as-of fallback only if some WISMO contacts had no in-window order.

attribute_by_erc/n12.summary: Drops the nulled order-side columns and attrib_strategy from the missed WISMO rows so that they can be re-joined.

attribute_by_erc/n13.summary: Runs backward as-of attribution on the missed WISMO contacts against all orders, with no window limit. Rows with null dates are dropped by default.
attribute_by_erc/n13.watch: The as-of join has no window, so the match can be an order older than the WISMO window.

attribute_by_erc/n14.summary: Labels fallback rows asof_fallback if an order was found, else no_match, and appends them to parts.

attribute_by_erc/b16.summary: Runs only if there are Returns contacts.

attribute_by_erc/n17.summary: Attributes Returns contacts with plain backward as-of; the Returns window is not used.

attribute_by_erc/n18.summary: Labels Returns rows asof_fallback or no_match from whether an order date is present, and appends them to parts.

attribute_by_erc/b19.summary: Runs only if there are Other (including null-ERC) contacts.

attribute_by_erc/n20.summary: Attributes Other and null-ERC contacts with plain backward as-of per by_cols.

attribute_by_erc/n21.summary: Sets attrib_strategy to asof_fallback if an order matched, else no_match, and appends the Other frame to parts.

attribute_by_erc/b22.summary: Checks whether no branch produced any output, which happens only when no contacts were added.

attribute_by_erc/n23.summary: When parts is empty, runs the as-of attribution on the empty contacts and adds a null String attrib_strategy column. Returns this empty frame in the normal output shape.
attribute_by_erc/n23.watch: Despite the comment, parts is also empty if every branch's frame was skipped.

attribute_by_erc/n24.summary: Stacks all branch frames with diagonal_relaxed concat, which unions columns and relaxes dtypes. Missing columns become null. Returns the result in branch order (WISMO hits, WISMO fallback, Returns, Other), not the input order.
attribute_by_erc/n24.watch: Row order is not the input order.

stages.name: Settings
stages.summary: Constants for ERC sets, windows, strategy labels and GNR/DOR intentions.

stages.name: CLI & load
stages.summary: Parse arguments and read the parquet inputs.

stages.name: Legacy asof
stages.summary: Validate dates and join each contact to the latest prior order.

stages.name: ERC routing
stages.summary: Validate inputs and split contacts into WISMO, Returns and Other.

stages.name: WISMO checks
stages.summary: Pick one order per WISMO contact by bucket and tier, with a label for the rule used.

stages.name: Branch merge
stages.summary: Run the WISMO fallback, Returns and Other as-of branches and stack the results.

stages.name: Report & write
stages.summary: Report the match rate and write the parquet output.
